# Setup

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(GGally)
})

# Set specific directory for desired QA results
setwd("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/data/")

# Upload data
QA_metrics <- read_tsv("strict_rodentia_qa_results_GeMoMa.tsv")

QA_metrics <- QA_metrics %>%
  mutate(Status = factor(Status, levels = c("PASS", "FAIL")),
         Identity = as.numeric(Identity),
         Query_Cov = as.numeric(Query_Cov),
         Len_Ratio = as.numeric(Len_Ratio)
         )

```

# Make ggpair plots

```{r}
# Custom diagonal that handles zero/near-zero variance
safe_density <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  # Extract column name from ggpairs mapping
  x_var <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  x_vals <- data[[x_var]]
  
  # Check per-group variance
  groups <- split(x_vals, data$Status)
  min_sd <- min(sapply(groups, function(g) sd(g, na.rm = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (is.na(min_sd) || min_sd < 0.5) {
    # Near-zero variance: use histogram instead, density not feasbile
    ggplot(data, mapping) +
      geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density), fill = Status),
                     alpha = 0.5, position = "identity", bins = 30) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("PASS" = "#F8766D", "FAIL" = "#00BFC4")) +
      theme_grey()
  } else {
    # Normal case: density with SJ bandwidth
    ggplot(data, mapping) +
      geom_density(aes(fill = Status), alpha = 0.5, bw = "SJ") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("PASS" = "#F8766D", "FAIL" = "#00BFC4")) +
      theme_grey()
  }
}
plots <- ggpairs(QA_metrics,
                 columns = c("Identity", "Query_Cov", "Len_Ratio"),
                 aes(colour = Status, alpha = 0.7),
                 title = "Piezo1 GeMoMa QA Metrics",
                 columnLabels = c("Identity (%)", "Query Coverage (%)", "Length Ratio (%)"),
                 progress = FALSE,
                 diag = list(continuous = safe_density)
                 )

print(plots)

# save plot

ggsave("QA_metrics_assessment_rodentia_GeMoMa.png",
       plot = plots,
       path = "//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/gianl/piezo1_pipeline/data_analysis/plots",
       width = 9,
       height = 8,
       dpi = 600)
```
